blocks.text: Jologs or Jolog (Singular) is a subculture in the Philippines that emerged in the late 1990s to the late 2000s, with a colloquial term describing a rebellious, working-class subculture or an individual style often viewed by mainstream society as loud, tacky or lacking refinement. Similar to Olderbrothercore, the Mexican-American subculture Cholo, and Ah Beng from Singapore/Malaysia, its specific clothing type includes baggy streetwear, a bandana, sunglasses, headcaps, checkered polos, and a jersey tank top that is related to basketball and Hip-Hop.

It often centers on the prominence of pop culture phenomena perceived as mainstream or commercialized, which can incorporate music genres (such as Hip-Hop, Post-Grunge and Rock/Metal), fashion, and any media that fit this aesthetic.
The Jologs subculture varies through music, animations, arts and conformity with visuals that feature sense of rebellion, edginess, and action (can be romantic, soft and tragic).

The coined term refers to the 1990s Filipino pop icon Jolina Magdangal, whose maximalist, colorful style was widespread among the masses. It originated from a "Jolina Organization" or was called "Jolens," integrating "Jol" with "og" (a common slang suffix for a "follower"), which became Jologs. It stems from "Diyolog," a portmanteau term of Tuyo (dried fish), Dilis (anchovy), and Itlog (egg). This meal-related term reflects the naming structure of popular Pinoy breakfast plates like Tapsilog.

The Bebot subculture is a style in the Philippines describing Filipina beauty by featuring early 2000s Philippine pop culture, similar to Mcbling. It is a maximalist aesthetic that claims Filipina features such as dark hair, tanned skin and brown eyes through a Y2K influence. It starts with looking casual or "bare-faced" before changing to a full-glam "Bebot" (a slang for a stylish/hot girl or a baddie) look using the song "Bebot" by The Black Eyed Peas. as a term for the style.

Kikay is a vibrant Filipino subculture, similar to the Tweencore aesthetic, that features the expression of beauty, hyper-femininity, and playful personal style originated in the 1990s- early 2000s pop culture and was popularized by Jolina Magdangal, who was prevalent through this aesthetic. It centers on optimism, joy and confidence.
